title: 第九章 秋生顿悟第十章 极度凶残
content_zh:
;;
老者懵逼了。
不懵不行。
要知道这尸体是他用蜻蜓点水穴花费十多年时间养成的绝品僵尸，不是那种普通僵尸可以媲美的，可为什么，头没了？？
头呢？
难道被那几脚给踢碎了？
开玩笑！
那得需要多么狂暴的力量？
老者对此完全无法理解。
“你就是那风水先生吧？”九叔来到秦尧身边，望着此人问道。
老者看都没看他一眼，反而是抬头死死盯着秦尧：“你坏了我十多年的心血，要怎么赔？”
秦尧一脸平静模样：“你养的这头僵尸差点伤到我师父，这笔帐该怎么算？”
“你也说了，是差点伤到，那就是没伤到。但你确确实实打碎了我的僵尸头颅。”老者说道。
秦尧嗤笑：“你的僵尸？你是问过任太爷的意见，还是问过任家人的意见？”
老者冷哼一声：“休得胡搅蛮缠！后生，我记住你了，终有一日，我会将你也炼成僵尸，为我驱使。”
“锵。”
九叔翻手间抽出身后背着的桃木剑，疾速冲向老者。
老者拖着任太爷的尸体，一路退至山崖边，飞身跃下：“还有，任发，我们之间的账没完，慢慢等着我的报复吧。”
任发：“……”
他从未有一刻像现在这么后悔过。

得罪谁不好，偏偏得罪了一个风水师。
自己这些年来积攒的是金银财宝，对方这些年来增长的可是法术修为。
当年几个家仆就能打死的人如今已经能够腾云驾雾，养尸炼魔了，就连自己都成为了对方的猎物。
如今想想果真是应了那句老话：打蛇不死，必受其害啊！
“九叔，您是咱们任家镇的守护神，您可一定要救救我啊！”回过神后，任发扑通一声跪倒在九叔面前，神色惊慌地说道。
九叔伸手将其扶了起来，转目问道：“秦尧，你怎么看？”
秦尧道：“只有千日做贼，哪能千日防贼？那风水师为了复仇，足足等了十多年，可以料想，他还能继续等下去，师父你总不能一辈子都待在任府之中，守护着任家人吧？”
任发一听这个又慌了，扭头望了眼自家闺女，见其还在神游天外，连忙拉了拉她衣角，想要让她向九叔的这名弟子求求情。
到了现在，他哪还能看不出来，九叔十分器重这名三弟子，虽没到言听计从的程度，但除了原则性的事情之外，都有商量。
只希望这位三弟子英雄不过美人关，肯看在婷婷的面子上，帮助任家渡此难关。
被任发先后拉了两下，傻了眼的任婷婷这才回过神来，浑浑噩噩间没能领会到父亲的意思，张口问道：“刚刚的那个人，会飞？”
任发脸色一黑，斥道：“任家都快完了，你还有心情关注别人会不会飞？还不赶紧跪下，求秦先生救命！”
content_en:
;;
The old man was confused.
It’s impossible not to be confused.
You must know that this corpse is a top-notch zombie that he spent more than ten years cultivating using dragonflies in water holes. It is not the kind of ordinary zombie that can be compared. But why is the head missing? ?
Where is the head?
Was it broken by those kicks?
joke!
How much violent power does that require?
The old man couldn't understand this at all.
"Are you that Feng Shui master?" Uncle Jiu came to Qin Yao and looked at him and asked.
The old man didn't even look at him. Instead, he raised his head and stared at Qin Yao: "You ruined my hard work for more than ten years. How can I compensate you?"
Qin Yao looked calm: "The zombie you raised almost hurt my master. How should this debt be settled?"
"You also said that it was almost hurt, but it was not hurt. But you did smash my zombie's head." The old man said.
Qin Yao sneered: "Your zombie? Have you asked Mr. Ren for his opinion, or have you asked the Ren family for their opinion?"
The old man snorted coldly: "Don't mess around! I will remember you, my descendant. One day, I will turn you into a zombie and drive you around."
"Qiang."
Uncle Jiu took out the mahogany sword from his back and rushed towards the old man.
The old man dragged Mr. Ren's body back to the edge of the cliff and jumped down: "Also, Ren Fa, the debt between us is not over yet. Please wait for my revenge."
Ren Fa: "..."
He had never regretted it as much as he did now.
It's not good to offend anyone, but I offended a Feng Shui master.
What he has accumulated over the years is gold and silver, while what the other party has gained over the years is his magic cultivation.
People who could be beaten to death by a few servants in the past are now able to fly in the clouds, raise corpses and refine demons, and even themselves have become the prey of the other party.
Now that I think about it, it really agrees with the old saying: If you don't kill a snake, you will suffer from it!
"Uncle Jiu, you are the patron saint of our town, Ren. You must save me!" After coming to his senses, Ren Fa knelt down in front of Uncle Jiu and said with a panicked expression.
Uncle Jiu stretched out his hand to help him up, turned around and asked, "Qin Yao, what do you think?"
Qin Yao said: "You can only be a thief for a thousand days, but how can you prevent a thief for a thousand days? The Feng Shui master has been waiting for more than ten years for revenge. It can be expected that he can continue to wait. Master, you can't stay in the Ren Mansion and protect the Ren family all your life, right?"
When Ren Fa heard this, he panicked again. He turned to look at his daughter and saw that she was still wandering. He quickly tugged at the corner of her clothes, trying to get her to beg for mercy from Uncle Jiu's disciple.
Until now, he still couldn't see that Uncle Jiu valued this third disciple very much. Although he didn't follow his advice, he discussed everything except principled matters.
I just hope that this third disciple hero is not a beauty, and is willing to help the Ren family overcome this difficulty for Tingting's sake.
After being pulled twice by Ren Fa, the dumbfounded Ren Tingting came back to her senses. She was so confused that she failed to understand what her father meant. She opened her mouth and asked, "That person just now, can fly?"
Ren Fa's face darkened and he scolded: "The Ren family is almost dead, and you still have the mood to care about whether others can fly? Why don't you kneel down quickly and beg Mr. Qin for help!"
